stories.title: Shoreline Stabilization Grant Application
stories.summary: The council considered Resolution No. 2024-3352 to apply for an Illinois EPA Section 319(h) Nonpoint Source Pollution Control Grant to fund shoreline stabilization at Lake Paradise and Lake Mattoon. The total project cost is $260,000, with $156,000 requested from state grant funds and $104,000 provided in local matching funds.

stories.title: Watershed Management Planning Update
stories.summary: Council Member Cox reported on attending the third meeting of the watershed management group on September 9th. He noted significant progress in data collection that will inform future watershed planning and support upcoming grant applications.

stories.title: Resident concern
stories.summary: Jason Little, a Lake Mattoon property owner residing in Neoga, presented concerns regarding historical 1956 flowage easements and severe sediment accumulation that has reduced water depth behind properties from 15 feet to under 3 feet. He noted that the city generates approximately $4.3 million annually from the lakes while surrounding non-resident communities bear environmental costs. Response: Mayor Hall acknowledged the issue and stated that city officials would need to gather as a group or establish a small committee to review the legal documents and meet with property owners.

stories.title: Dam repairs are coming! Council Decision Request 2026-2732 awarding $74,200 bid to Fuller-Wente, Inc. for Lake Mattoon Dam repairs and authorizing IDOT contract execution
stories.summary: The council considered Council Decision Request 2026-2732 to award a $74,200 contract to Fuller-Wente, Inc. for repairs to the Lake Mattoon Dam. Commissioner Clawson reported that the project involves patching the spillway flume, which required waiting until lake water levels receded below the spillway crest. The bid came in below the city's expected cost estimate.
